name: Pearl Dental
description: A Philadelphia general dentistry practice offering routine checkups, cleanings, and restorative care.

hero.headline: Pearl Dental
hero.sub: Routine care, restorative work, and a team that explains every step before doing it.

items: Routine exams and professional cleanings for the whole family
Restorative dentistry including fillings and crowns
Cosmetic consultations for whitening and smile improvements
New patients welcome, most insurance accepted
Modern equipment and a comfort-first exam room
Clear treatment plans explained before any work begins

story.heading: About
paragraphs: Pearl Dental was built around a simple idea: dental visits should not be something patients dread.
The practice focuses on prevention first, so small issues get caught before they become expensive ones.

items: Book an appointment and get a straightforward explanation of what a visit involves.
No surprise upsells -- treatment plans are reviewed with you before anything is scheduled.
A calm, modern office designed to take the edge off a dental visit.

feature.heading: Preventive care that catches problems early
feature.text: Regular cleanings and exams cost less than emergency work down the road -- and they hurt a lot less too.

spotlight.heading: Restorative and cosmetic options
spotlight.text: From a simple filling to a full smile consultation, treatment is scoped to what you actually need.
